# Gymglish

> > Gymglish offers AI-powered adaptive language learning through daily personalized lessons, featuring Frantastique for French (in partnership with Larousse) and other language courses with cultural immersion.

Gymglish delivers micro-learning language courses via email and mobile apps, using adaptive algorithms to personalize content based on learner performance. The platform includes Frantastique for French learners (FLE), with courses available across multiple countries and supported by Aimigo AI technology.

## Key Topics

- Gymglish
- Frantastique
- Larousse partnership
- AI-powered adaptive learning
- French language learning (FLE)
- Daily personalized lessons
- Micro-learning methodology
- Cultural immersion
- Level testing and placement
- Aimigo by Gymglish
- Mobile apps (App Store, Play Store)
- Free trial registration
- Multilingual support
- Belgium, France, Canada availability

## French Learning (Frantastique)

- [Frantastique French Course with Larousse](https://cours-francais.larousse.fr.gymglish.com/): Frantastique French learning partnership with Larousse - daily lessons
- [French Level Test & Free Trial](https://cours-francais.larousse.fr.gymglish.com/test): French level test and free trial registration for Frantastique
